evidence: Wiener Linien 2024 press release: '2024 konnten die Wiener Linien 873 Millionen Fahrgaeste begruessen'. Wiener Linien operates U-Bahn, Strassenbahn AND Autobus; the 873,000,000 stored here is the agency total, not the rail-only figure the system string ('U-Bahn + Strassenbahn Wien') implies.

data.praha.eu reports 1,104,935,520 for 2024 across the whole Prague Integrated Transport (PID) network, broken down metro ~36% (~379M), tram ~33%, city bus ~26%, regional bus ~5%. The stored value matches exactly, so it is an agency-wide figure ~2.9x the metro alone. Confirms the hypothesis in comparability.py's docstring.

The cited MVG release reports '621 Millionen Fahrgaeste ... mit U-Bahn, Bus und Tram' for 2025 and does not mention S-Bahn. The stored figure is 442,000,000 for 2025, which matches neither that total nor the system string 'U-Bahn + S-Bahn Muenchen' (MVG does not operate the S-Bahn). Scope cannot be established from the citation on file.

BVG in Zahlen 2024 reports Fahrgastfahrten (UBF) of 1,109.7 Mio for 2024 (1,066.3 for 2023), split U-Bahn 554.3 / Strassenbahn 226.1 / Omnibus einschliesslich Faehre 459.2 -- bus included, S-Bahn absent (S-Bahn Berlin is a separate DB company). The stored 1,010,300,000 matches no figure in the source, and the system string 'U-Bahn + S-Bahn Berlin' misstates coverage in both directions.
